timing_method: 0.25 degree geographic cell × country × UTC date × source day/night. Minimum absolute acquisition-minute gap, no midnight wrap. Cells unequal-area; no individual fire pairing. Fractions condition on shared detections; not recall or coverage.
coverage_limit: Source date spans and reported detections are NOT valid-observation or clear-sky coverage. Missing detections retain unknown observation status.

harmonization.status: Exploratory baseline only; NOT calibrated or harmonized
harmonization.training: 2019 country-level Aqua/VIIRS total ratios, fit only on months positive in both
harmonization.holdout: Entire 2020 calendar year; months positive in both; countries also present in training
limitations: Conditional on positive detections; not a clear-sky exposure model.
Ratio is a weak comparator, not a deployable harmonization method.
